title: George Harrison marries Olivia Arias | 1978
content:
George Harrison married Olivia Arias on 2 September 1978.

Arias began working for A&M Records in 1972 in Hollywood. Two years later, while working at their merchandising department, she began speaking regularly on the telephone to Harrison, whose record label Dark Horse Records was distributed by A&M.

Jerry Moss [A&M co-founder] put my mom on the Dark Horse project because she was the only person cool enough there. She was a meditator, and they figured she would get on with my dad real well, which evidently she did. I was one of their early releases.
Dhani Harrison
Rolling Stone, 9 March 2020

Harrison invited her to work exclusively for his label, and in October 1974 he flew out to meet her in Los Angeles. They became inseparable, and she became a pillar of strength during the aftermath of his marriage to Pattie Boyd, and the declining commercial performance of his solo career.

Their son Dhani was born on 1 August 1978, and the following month George and Olivia married in a private ceremony at Henley-on-Thames Register Office. The media was not informed of the wedding until 8 September.

Harrison hired mariachi group Sol de México to perform at the wedding ceremony. In 1998 he hired them again to arrange a Spanish-language version of ‘Dark Sweet Lady’ for Olivia.

We played at their wedding in 1976 [sic], they have always been in contact with us and when George died, he gave my foundation $30,000 to teach mariachi classes in Los Angeles. Olivia invited us to make a presentation for the George Harrison Foundation together with the London Symphony, as well as a tour of Russia, with four concerts with Fernando de la Mora
José Hernández, Sol de México
